lines.text: The LORD will lead her to the wilderness, give back her vineyards, and make the Valley of Achor a gateway of hope.
There she will respond as she did in the days of her youth, as in the day she came up out of Babylon.
She will call the LORD 'my Husband,' and He will remove the names of the Baals from her lips.
The LORD will make a covenant with the beasts, birds and crawling creatures, and abolish bow and sword and battle.
The grain, new wine and oil will respond to Jezreel, and the LORD will sow her as His own in the land.
